content: Shall be able to standardize architecture 23 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 536: AUTOSAR_RS_StandardizationTemplate Requirements on Standardization Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The Standardization Template shall be able to express standardization of components and communication, even if AUTOSAR does not standardize architecture of application software. This requirement covers a set of communicating components. Rationale: This allows to leverage AUTOSAR standardization principles inside a company.
